notes.title: THE GAME IS TOTALLY SAFE!
notes.content:
Some articles on the web talk about my game, but they also forgot to say that my game is totally safe. There is no malware. The only virus you can find is the virus that you will fight in the game. ːsteamboredː

Enjoy this free game!

notes.title: First release!
notes.content:
It's launch day! After 15 long years, NanoWar is finally available on PC.
Thank you for your support and go kill this virus! ːsteammockingː
